verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance automation platform, so custom frameworks and controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows pre-mapped controls and built-in frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS). Nothing documents creating custom frameworks, custom controls, user-defined tests or custom evidence requirements. The ingestion webhooks and custom integration push APIs cover data intake, not authoring controls.
